tagline: An open-source, auditable network gateway for homes and servers
intro: DDNS, STUN traversal, port forwarding, reverse proxy, SSL certificates, WAF and more in a single binary. Every line of code is public and every outbound address is visible.
upToDate: You are on the latest version
versionIncomparable: Cannot compare the current version {current} with the latest version {latest}; please check whether you need to upgrade
updateHint: With automatic checks on, Gately contacts GitHub every 12 hours to read the release list and security advisories, sending no information; turn them off and GitHub is contacted only when you click Check for updates.

upgrade.title: Online upgrade
upgrade.confirm: Gately will download {latest} from GitHub, verify its SHA-256, test-run it, replace {exe} and restart. The previous version is kept as {exe}.old. Export a configuration backup before upgrading.
upgrade.uploadConfirm: Gately will replace the current binary with {name} and restart. Accepts the Linux tar.gz from the releases page or the extracted gately binary. Any version works, so you can also roll back.

reason.os: Online upgrade is only supported on Linux. Download the new version and replace the binary manually.
reason.docker: Running in a container. Pull the new image and recreate the container (keep the config directory mounted).
reason.fnos: For the fnOS package, install the new .fpk manually in the App Center; your configuration is kept.
reason.opkg: Installed from the OpenWrt .ipk package. Download the new .ipk and upgrade with opkg install; your config is kept.
reason.apk: Installed from the OpenWrt .apk package. Download the new .apk and upgrade with apk add --allow-untrusted; your config is kept.
reason.readonly: The directory of the executable is not writable, so online upgrade is unavailable. Replace the binary manually.
reason.custom: This is a custom build, and online upgrade would install the full edition. Generate the new version with the same options at build.gately.cn, then upload it on the About page.

upgrade.keepOpen: Keep this page open; Gately restarts and reloads automatically when done.

proxy.label: Update proxy:
proxy.title: Update proxy
proxy.help: Used to reach GitHub when checking for updates and upgrading online. Supports http://, https:// and socks5://. Leave empty to connect directly; the HTTPS_PROXY environment variable is still honored. You can also change it under Settings → Network & Runtime.

dockerNote: The Docker image supports amd64, arm64 and arm/v7. Host networking is recommended so Gately can listen on the host's ports.
binaryNote: You can also download Linux / macOS / Windows / FreeBSD binaries from {releases} and run {cmd}.
stepExportDesc: Find {file} in the Lucky config directory, or the full-site config zip.
stepImportDesc: Upload it in {link}, preview, then import. Imported rules are disabled by default.
stepSwitchDesc: Module by module, disable it in Lucky and enable it in Gately. Stop Lucky once everything checks out.

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.desc: The source code is open under Apache-2.0. Anyone can review, build and contribute.

noTelemetry.title: No data sent back
noTelemetry.desc: Gately never contacts project servers or reports device information. Third-party login uses your own OAuth app.

visibleAddr.title: Visible outbound addresses
visibleAddr.desc: Every outbound address, such as public IP lookup, STUN servers and the GitHub update check, is visible, editable and can be turned off.

plainConfig.title: Plain-text config
plainConfig.desc: Configuration is plain JSON that you can put under git for auditing and rollback.

autoCheck.label: Automatic update checks
autoCheck.pending: Automatic checks are on; the first check runs a few minutes after startup
autoCheck.off: Automatic checks are off; GitHub is contacted only when you click Check for updates

security.title: The current version {current} is affected by published security issues
security.releases: These newer versions contain security fixes: {versions}
security.advice: Please upgrade to {latest} as soon as possible.
security.noFix: You are already on the latest version. Until a fixed version is released, follow the mitigations in the advisory.

build.rebuild: Build a new version with these options
